text.title: Architectural Impact PR Ranking Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a time-boxed architecture review session with a fixed slot, and a defined PR population (repositories plus a window of opened or merged timestamps) to rank for it?

branch.conclusion: Skip. Without a time-box and a population there is nothing to rank against; set up the session and the repo list first.

branch.question: Are all score signals computed from the diff, file list, manifests and contract paths, with no PR title, label, author or description in the formula?

branch.conclusion: Rewrite the scorer to read `git diff --name-status`, manifests and the contract path list; drop every metadata term from the formula.

branch.question: Is the public API path list committed per repository, and does the summed read estimate of the top N fit the session's time-box?

branch.conclusion: Commit the per-repo list of schema, migration, export and event paths; until then the report prints "no API surface list" for that repo.
Print line counts and read estimates, cut N to the time-box, and list the remainder as deferred with their scores.
Run the full procedure: published weights, dependency kinds, window and exclusion reconciliation, merged-without-review section, hit or miss record; emit the report per the output contract.

example.p: Session is Monday 10:00, 45 minutes; population is three repos, PRs opened or merged in the last seven days. Scorer uses file lists and manifests. Repo `payments` has no committed public API path list → conclusion r-public-api-surface-enumerated-per-repo; the report ships with "no API surface list" for `payments` until the list lands.
